Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely accepted an erroneous claim from Wikipedia that Imanol Uribe was married to Pastora Vega, ignoring earlier corroborating sources indicating María Barranco (1982–2004) as his spouse. This misattribution conflated Uribe with actor Imanol Arias (who was linked to Pastora Vega) and propagated the error despite conflicting evidence, instead of triangulating with multiple credible sources.
